audit.whatIsWrong: The spikes cited 'Fenestrated Deceit', 'Trail of Torment' and 'passive canvas repositioning', and gave Nimble Fighter tenacity.
audit.why: None of those names exist. Hwei's four spells are Signature of the Visionary (P), Subject: Disaster (Q), Subject: Serenity (W), Subject: Torment (E), Spiraling Despair (R); his utility palette is Subject: Serenity. Fizz's passive is unit-walking plus flat damage reduction.
audit.corrected: spikes[0], spikes[1], spikes[2] and mid rewritten on the real names.

audit.whatIsWrong: The tracked spell was written throughout as 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' — a fabricated name — with no cooldown anywhere, and packet.defects flagged that no Hwei ability is ever named correctly.
audit.why: The CC palette is Subject: Torment (E) at 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, carrying Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw. Subject: Disaster (Q) is 10/9/8/7/6 and Subject: Serenity (W), his shield palette, is 18/17.5/17/16.5/16.
audit.corrected: focus.text, winCon, enemyWin, loading, breakdown.cooldowns, both Do's bodies, the Don't, feeding, early and carry all now name Subject: Torment with real cooldowns.

audit.why: Every commit is gated on the CC palette being spent, and nothing said how long that is.
audit.corrected: The 12-second rank-1 Subject: Torment now appears in the cooldowns field, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d and loading.
